harbour_quay.name: Harbour Quay
harbour_quay.block: A long stone quay curving around a small grey harbour. Rowing boats tied to iron rings along the edge, stacks of lobster pots, coils of rope, a row of tall iron lamp posts, a squat bell tower at the far end and low whitewashed houses with slate roofs behind.

net_loft.name: Net Loft
net_loft.block: A long attic room above the boat shed. Bare wooden beams, nets hung from hooks along both walls, a workbench under a round window, wooden floats in baskets, a narrow ladder in the floor and one oil lamp on a chain above the bench.
